g.title: G
g.text: FSM digital logic — representative RTL circuit

g.title: note
g.text: Logical circuit, not a technology-mapped netlist.
State register resets asynchronously; other transitions
occur on the rising clock edge. A held state selects
its current value for D. The compute FSM uses the
same register + decode + next-value mux structure.
done_o is a separate flip-flop (see control diagram).
